row.name: Kids R Kids of West Temple

occurrences.finding: Nutrition and Food Service - Child must not go more than 3 hours: During the course of the investigation, the operation was found deficient for this Minimum Standard. The operation failed to provide the child with lunch, resulting in the child going more than three hours between food service. Although the child was provided an AM snack and a PM snack, the snacks did not prevent the child from exceeding the three-hour period without food required by Minimum Standards.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Nutrition and Food Service - Child must not go more than 3 hours (26 TAC §746.3301(d))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: During inspection two caregivers provided the wrong number of how many children were present during their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During investigation it was found that a child was left unattended in the classroom for a few seconds.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: During inspection two caregivers provided the wrong number of how many children were present during their care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: During the investigation, the operation was found deficient with this Minimum Standard as there is evidence that supports a caregiver lifted a child by one arm only.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional: An infant was not given a bottle during the timeframe that was noted on the infant feeding instructions. The infant feeding instructions stated that the infant needs to be fed every 2-3 hours and the infant was given a bottle after 4 hours.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Written Feeding Instructions - Signed and Dated by Parent or Health-Care Professional (26 TAC §746.2421(a))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Incident/Illness Form: It was found that an incident report was not completed for an infant that was given the wrong breastmilk.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Incident/Illness Form (26 TAC §746.603(a)(7))

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups: During an investigation it was found that a bottle was not labeled with the infants first name and last initial. There was also a bottle not labeled during the inspection today. This was corrected when the bottle was labled.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants - Label Bottles/Cups (26 TAC §746.2419(6))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: Observed a plastic slide that was missing part of the roofing.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface: Observed a diaper changing mat that was ripped in one of the classrooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diaper Changing Equipment - Smooth, Non-absorbent, Easy to Clean Surface (26 TAC §746.3503(a))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for: Observed one caregiver state that they had 10 children but there were 11 children in the classroom.   Observed a second classroom state that they had 17 children but they had 16 children in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Caregivers - Know number of children responsible for (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(2))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training: Observed one caregiver who has worked at the operation for over a year and only has 16 hours of training for the year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees, Caregivers, and Directors - Pre-Service Training (26 TAC §746.1301(a)(2)(A))

occurrences.finding: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children: Observed a caregivers purse in the bathroom in the reach of children with two bottles of medication in the purse. The bottles of medication were at the top of the purse and could be seen just by walking by the purse. This was corrected whent he purse was put out of the reach of the children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Storage of Medication - Inaccessible to Children (26 TAC §746.3807(1))

occurrences.finding: Employee Handwashing Before Eating or Handling Food: During an investigation it was found that caregivers sometimes use gloves instead of washing their hands to serve food.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Employee Handwashing Before Eating or Handling Food (26 TAC §746.3415(1))

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing Before Eating: Children should wash hands prior to eatting any meal served at the operation to prevent the spread of germs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing Before Eating (26 TAC §746.3417(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: A child was observed on video footage being smacked on the leg by a caregiver. A child was also observed on video being picked up roughly and placed down into a chair in an aggressive manner. A child was observed on video being placed on the floor, hitting their back against the wall in an aggressive manner.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Caregiver appeared by video to place a child down at a chair using more than normal force. Caregiver appeared to be flustered and not have control of their actions.  Caregiver was terminated by operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During the investigation, there was sufficient evidence found to determine that a child was not being adequately supervised when the child was bitten multiple times before a teacher noticed and intervened.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Only to Child for Whom Intended: During the investigation, there was sufficient evidence found to determine that the operation had over-the-counter medication that was being used for multiple children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Only to Child for Whom Intended (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(2))

occurrences.finding: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two: During the investigation, there was sufficient evidence found to determine that children under two years old were watching media on an iPad.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Screen Time Activities - Not Used for Under Two (26 TAC §746.2207(a))

occurrences.finding: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner: In one of the children's bathrooms, there was a garbage can with dirty diapers that did not have a lid on it. This was corrected during the inspection when a lid was placed on the garbage can.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Garbage Inaccessible to Children; Maintained in Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3407(8))

occurrences.finding: Fire Extinguishers Serviced: The fire extinguisher in one of the vehicles needed to be serviced as the needle was in the red.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Fire Extinguishers Serviced (26 TAC §746.5307(b))

occurrences.finding: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products: The director had not reviewed the children's product recall list. This was corrected during the inspection when the director was shown how to subscribe to the recall emails.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Products- Review list and Remove unsafe products (26 TAC §746.4135(a))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: During the DFPS investigation, there was sufficient evidence to show that a caregiver spanked a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: A caregiver was observed caring for children, and she did not have a cleared background check. The caregiver left the operation during the inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - used at all times when transporting a child in care: During a DFPS investigation, it was found the electronic safety alarm was disabled and not being used when transporting children in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Electronic Child Safety Alarm - used at all times when transporting a child in care (26 TAC §746.5625(c))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During a DFPS investigation, it was found a child was left unsupervised for approximately two hours on a transportation vehicle.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: During a DFPS investigation, it was found a child in care was neglected.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: During an investigation it was observed through video footage that caregivers were sitting down on the playground not properly supervising the children when a child in care was injured.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age: An infant was sleeping in a crib with a burp cloth in the crib near the infants face. The burp cloth was removed from the crib.   An administrative penalty will be recommended as a result of this citation, per HRC ?42.078.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Cribs - Only Snug Fitting Sheet and Crib Mattress Cover Allowed if Infant Younger than 12 Months of Age (26 TAC §746.2415(b))

occurrences.finding: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect, Exploitation-May not delegate responsibility to report: During an investigation it was found that a caregiver was aware of allegations of   abuse and did not report the incidents.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Reporting Suspected Abuse, Neglect, Exploitation-May not delegate responsibility to report (26 TAC §746.201(5))

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: A caregiver did not use good judgment when they picked a child up by the childs   leg and one arm to lay the child on their mat.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: The operation added a tall shelf to a classroom bathroom but did not anchor it to the wall. A child was able to climb on the shelf which caused the shelf to fall and injure a child in care. This was corrected when the shelf was removed from the bathroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization: The operation had completed a boo boo report, but had not completed the licensing incident report for a child who received an injury while in care which required medical attention. This was corrected when the operation completed the correct incident report.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Licensing Incident/Illness Report Form - Injuries Requiring Medical Treatment or Hospitalization (26 TAC §746.701(1))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A caregiver was changing a young child in the bathroom and had up to 4 more children behind the caregiver. The caregiver could not see the other children in the bathroom and a child was able to climb on a tall unanchored shelf causing it to tip over and injure a child in care.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer: Observed 5 infants sitting in infant high chairs without safety straps being used. There were no safety straps on the chairs due to them being washed. This was corrected when the straps were added to the chairs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Chairs - Safety Straps Used if Required by Manufacturer (26 TAC §746.4501(b))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual: Observed a caregiver snatch a toy from a child, grab a childs arm and then picked the child up by the childs hand as the child's feet left the floor and took the child to another area in the classroom.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - No Harsh, Cruel or Unusual (26 TAC §746.2805)

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Observed two caregivers with access to the children who did not have a cleared background check at this operation. This was corrected when the caregivers were asked to leave the operation and a background check was put it.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)

occurrences.finding: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months: Observed a 2 month old infant sitting in a boncy seat while the caregiver sat beside the infant holding the infants bottle. This was corrected when the caregiver was told that infants under 6 months old must be held to be fed and the infant was picked up.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirements for Feeding Infants-Hold through 6-months (26 TAC §746.2419(1))

occurrences.finding: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner: Observed dirty diapers on the floor of the bathroom. This was corrected when the diapers where thrown in the trash,
occurrences.violation_type_title: Diapering Procedures-Soiled Diapers Kept in a Sanitary Manner (26 TAC §746.3505(f))

occurrences.finding: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation: Observed 14 staff without cleared background checks. This is being corrected by scheduling FBI fingerprint appointments for the staff.   An administrative penalty will be recommended as a result of this citation, per HRC ?42.078.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Background check results - Must receive notification prior to allowing subject to be present at your operation (26 TAC §745.641)
